8295.title: Successful catalog refresh discards previously advertised models
8295.rootCauseOneLine: Successful model refreshes replace and persist both catalog arrays without completeness detection, dropping omitted IDs at an unchanged fingerprint.
8295.proposedFix: Define how incomplete provider discovery differs from genuine model removal before adding retention or a completeness contract.
8295.caveats: Confirmed at the real server catalog boundary in two clean checkouts with synthetic host RPC responses; the upstream OpenCode startup race and installed CLI recovery were not exercised. Full regression patch is inline in the HTML report.
